title: Figure 2: Components of a Closed-Loop BMI Control System (block diagram)
description: Block diagram titled "Components of a Closed-loop BMI Control System" showing a green oval labeled "Brain" linked through "Output interface" and "Output signal processing" boxes to an "External Device," which feeds back via "Input signal processing" and "Input interface" to the brain. A dashed box labeled "Additional sensory" also feeds into the brain. The caption reads "Figure 2. The General Layout of a Closed-Loop Control Interface" and notes that in an open-loop interface the input or output signal paths are absent.
